summary.intent: Change the release PR body composer so changes are grouped by bump level (Major/Minor/Patch), titled by a changeset's headline, and rendered as bullets when there is no extra detail; also document it in specs and the changelog.
summary.outcome: Implemented grouping, headline titles and bullet rendering in pr_body.rs and release_preview.rs, accepted the updated snapshot, ran clippy and unit tests, added spec REL-PR-10, a changeset and a plan doc, then committed and pushed branch feat/release-pr-headlines.

repo: Release PR body composition lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs and is snapshot-tested with insta; the snapshot is accepted via INSTA_UPDATE=always, then stray *.snap.new files must be removed.
Release PR behavior is specified in docs/specs/release.json under acceptance_criteria with ids like REL-PR-NN; the new criterion was added as REL-PR-10.
Changes need a .changeset/*.md file; the PR body renderer uses split_summary (release_preview.rs) to separate a changeset's headline from its detail.
Verification flow used: cargo fmt, cargo clippy -p callisto-graph -p callisto-cli --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test -p callisto-graph --lib, cargo build -p callisto-cli.
A change with bump level 'none' is treated as a patch when grouping.

code.finding: render_change now takes an after_bullet flag and returns whether it emitted a bullet, so consecutive bullets stay in one list and blank lines are inserted before <details> blocks; Major changes get <details open>.
Changeset entry text now uses summary.trim() instead of indent_changeset_summary, removing that import dependency from this file.

workflow: A worktree guard refuses shell heredocs that write files; write scripts with the Write tool and run them with python3 -I instead.
Grepping cargo test output for 'failed' matches passing test names; filter on '^test .*FAILED' or 'panicked' to see real failures.
Before starting a feature, check open PRs for file conflicts and grep docs/specs for areas that cover the change.

friction: Heredoc-based edit script was blocked by the worktree guard and had to be redone via the Write tool.
Initial test grep pattern was too broad and matched passing test names, requiring a rerun with a stricter filter.
open_items: The PLAN-release-notes.md plan doc was added and may need follow-up steps beyond 3a.
Other renderers or docs referencing the PR body format were searched for but the transcript doesn't confirm all were updated.
The open PR for the pushed branch is not shown as created in this segment.
